description: Plan dinners for the coming days and return the finished week in one call: the plan by day (varied bases and methods, perishables first, one meal new to the cook with why), the merged shopping list (list), prep_order, substitutions and one true line (say). Use when the cook says "what should we eat this week?", "plan dinners", "groceries for the week", "four dinners under $80" (max_budget), or has people over (occasion, guest_notes). Their preferences and pantry apply. Show the plan with say, ask the one question in next_steps, then the list; nothing is ordered. A swap goes to update_meal_plan with plan_id. Signed out it comes back unsaved (keep: true asks to sign in).

guest_notes.description: Who's coming and what they need, in the cook's words: "one vegetarian, Sam hates cilantro". Used to offer a version of a recipe; never stored as a preference

keep.description: Older spelling of save: true = save, false = preview. Still works; prefer save

max_budget.description: US dollars the plan's list should stay under ("plan the week under $80"): an estimate from national average prices, so say "about"

max_calories.description: Calories per serving at most for every meal; defaults to the cook's saved target

meals.description: How many meals to plan; leave out to use the cook's usual number (workflow.plan_meals in preferences), else 5

min_protein.description: Grams of protein per serving at least; defaults to the cook's saved target

occasion.description: weeknight: quick, everyday. guests or party: the plan comes with share links and an offer to adapt a recipe for a guest's needs before the list

request_key.description: Your own id or receipt.request_key. First save wins for this cook and tool: within 10 minutes the same key returns the saved plan, even if arguments changed. New arguments need a new key; edits use update_*. Without a key Befana fingerprints arguments and applied preferences/pantry

save.description: "preview": show the plan and keep nothing (no id, no url, nothing in My Kitchen), signed in or out; use it when the cook says "just show me", "don't save it yet", "an option". "save": keep it in the cook's kitchen (signed out: the sign-in error). Left out: a signed-in call saves, a signed-out call previews. The receipt in the result says which happened

servings.description: Servings per meal (defaults to each recipe's own)

units.description: US cups/oz/°F or metric grams/ml/°C. Defaults to the cook's setting.

name: plan_meals

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

cost.description: What the plan's list costs (#245), an estimate; a replay without a saved list labels a fresh estimate using the current pantry in line. say uses the savings when there are real ones

as_of.description: The month the prices are for ("2026-09"); null when nothing was priced

basis.description: store: the cook's own store quoted every priced line; reference: national average prices (BLS, USDA ERS)

missing.description: Lines left out of the total

partial.description: True when a line couldn't be priced: the total leaves it out. Name what's missing whenever you give a figure

saved_by_pantry.description: US dollars of things the cook already has that stayed off the list; null on a saved-plan replay because the original comparison was not kept

saved_by_sharing.description: US dollars the shared ingredients save against buying each recipe on its own, in whole packages; null on a saved-plan replay because the original comparison was not kept

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

list.description: The merged shopping list for the plan, pantry already off (with_shopping_list, the default): the same shape build_shopping_list returns, so "yes, make the list" needs no second call. Show it after the cook answers the plan's one question; lead with it when offer_shopping_list is always, leave it out of your reply when never. Delivery is offered then too, through order_groceries with its id (the order page is url + "/order")

buy.description: What to buy at the store, e.g. "1 head"; null when need is enough

buyCount.description: How many to put in a cart: packages of buy, or whole items for a counted ingredient

extra.description: Amounts shown beside the main one (a unit that could not be added)

flag.description: "Contains milk" when it hits the cook's allergies

fromRecipes.description: Slugs of the recipes that use it; empty for an extra the cook added

inPantry.description: On the check-the-pantry side: the cook has it or it's a staple

need.description: What the recipes call for, e.g. "10 cloves"

outcome.description: What the cook said happened at the store (#63), set with update_shopping_list outcomes; absent until they say

outcome_store.description: Where they bought it elsewhere, in the cook's own words; never suggested

why.description: On likely_have lines: a staple, or a small amount of a shelf-stable bulk item

forgot_asked.description: The id of the item "Did you forget?" already asked about on this list (#63): asked once per list

id.description: The saved list's id, for order_groceries and update_shopping_list (only when saved)

left_off.description: How many lines were left off because the cook has them: "left off 6 you have"

likely_have.description: Staples and small amounts of bulk items (3 tbsp flour, 4 tbsp wine) the cook probably has: set aside instead of a full-size purchase, not counted in the cost. Ask which they do need (they move to the aisles) and which they have (they come off) with update_shopping_list; absent on lists saved before this

pantry.description: What the cook already has, left off the buy list (count in left_off): check the pantry, don't buy

outcome_store.description: Where they bought it elsewhere, in the cook's own words; never suggested

why.description: On likely_have lines: a staple, or a small amount of a shelf-stable bulk item

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

saved.description: true: the list is in the cook's kitchen (id and url set); false: a preview, or the cook is signed out: nothing was kept

text.description: The list as plain text, for a message

next_steps.description: Suggestions, best first, each with its tool, args and effect. Befana suggests the top one in one sentence; whether any runs is decided by what the cook asks in the conversation and your confirmation rules, never by the wording here

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update, save_this…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

effect.description: What running it does (#308): read changes nothing; write changes the cook's kitchen (a save, a version, a list or pantry edit); order hands a list to a grocer (never a purchase); share is links to pass on. Apply your own confirmation rules by this

priority.description: 1 first; Befana suggests the top one

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. A suggestion: it never states what the cook asked for or agreed to

standing.description: The cook's own saved workflow setting behind this step when it is "always" (e.g. preferences.workflow.offer_shopping_list): a fact about their preferences to weigh with the conversation, not permission

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

nutrition.description: The plan's nutrition per serving (#244), an estimate

average_per_meal.description: One serving of each meal, averaged: a plan-day when it's one dinner a day

partial_meals.description: Meals whose numbers leave an ingredient out

occasion.description: The requested occasion; null when replaying a saved plan because it was not kept

day.description: The plan's day: Mon … Sun ("Mon (week 2)" past seven). update_meal_plan takes it to swap or drop the meal

new_to_you.description: The plan's one meal the cook hasn't saved, cooked or planned before

nutrition.description: Nutrition per serving (#244), an estimate; get_recipe has the detail

partial.description: True when an ingredient couldn't be counted: the numbers leave it out. Say what's missing whenever you give a number

per.description: "serving", or one of what the recipe makes ("cookie")

per_serving.description: Per serving, rounded like a label

print_url.description: One-page printable version of the recipe

reason.description: Why it's on this day, only when it matters ("fish first", "makes 8: lunch Thursday"); null otherwise

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

basis.description: author: the recipe's own estimate (+25%) until enough cooks finished; cooks: the crowd's range

for_you.description: Minutes for this cook, from their own pace, when they have one

n.description: Finished cooks behind a cooks range; 0 for the author's estimate

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

why.description: On the new-to-you meal: why it's here ("popular with Colorado cooks this month"). Say it with that meal

plan_id.description: The saved plan's id, for update_meal_plan; null on a preview or signed out

prep_order.description: What to cook first and why, from perishables, tags and servings. A suggestion the cook can ignore

reason.description: Why it sits here ("fish first: cook it within a day or two of shopping", "makes 8: one cook, two nights"); null when any night is fine

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

receipt.description: Whether this call kept anything, and what (#307)

created.description: True when this call created what it saved; false on a preview or when it reused the save from the same request a moment ago

deprecated.description: Present when the older keep flag decided the mode: it still works; save is the field to use

list_id.description: The saved list's id, null on a preview

mode.description: saved: it's in the cook's kitchen; preview: nothing was kept (no id, no url)

plan_id.description: plan_meals: the saved plan's id, null on a preview

request_key.description: Opaque cook/tool-scoped key; pass it unchanged as request_key on a retry. First save wins for 10 minutes even if arguments change; use a new key for a new save. Null on a preview

reused.description: True when a retry of the same request (same request_key, within 10 minutes) returned the plan or list already saved: no duplicate was made

say.description: What happened, in plain words: tell the cook when it matters ("nothing was saved", "already saved")

relaxed.description: The time limit was too tight, so the plan used the nearest one that fits: tell the cook

saved.description: true: the plan (and its list) is in the cook's kitchen; false: a preview, or the cook is signed out: nothing was kept

say.description: One true line about what the plan did for the cook, read off the list ("Three dinners share one bunch of cilantro and one onion"): say it with the plan

skipped_by_preferences.description: Recipes excluded while making this plan; null when replaying a saved plan because the original count was not kept

substitutions.description: Swaps for ingredients the cook's preferences flagged in the plan's recipes, the same swaps get_recipe({ substitute }) returns; empty when none. A version still needs the cook's yes (fork_recipe)

ingredient.description: The ingredient in that recipe the cook's preferences flagged, as the recipe writes it

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

amount_text.description: The amount to use at the requested servings and units, e.g. "6 tbsp olive oil"

from.description: The ingredient to replace, as the recipe writes it

why.description: Which preference flagged it, e.g. "on your avoid list"
